assessments.rationale: CH-U001-001 accurately presents the claim in SRC-U001-CLAIM-001 and the mechanism in SRC-U001-MECHANISM-001 at the permitted mechanistic ceiling.   "text": "A platform can provide genuine convenience while still extracting attention far beyond the value of that convenience. Because small benefits lower resistance to adoption, companies can later surround those benefits with engagement loops that capture unrelated time. If a tool is useful for one purpose, frequent use of the whole platform is justified. Usefulness must be judged against full cost; one good feature does not justify every attention demand attached to it."

Because small benefits lower resistance to adoption, companies can later surround those benefits with engagement loops that capture unrelated time.
